source.quote: Revenue reached $278.7 million, representing a 37% increase from $204.0 million in the prior year quarter
adjusted earnings per share of $1.16 for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 30, 2026, beating the analyst estimate of $0.54 by $0.62
adjusted operating income of $39.6 million increased $56.3 million, both as compared to the prior year quarter
The revenue growth was primarily driven by higher playoff-related revenues of $66.9 million
For the full fiscal year 2026, the company reported revenues of $1,153.8 million, an increase of 11% from the prior year
